metadata.construction_table_heading_as_reported: significant IBX data center projects under construction as of December 31, 2025
metadata.status_scope: The construction-table heading supports exactly one generic project-level under_construction observation for each of the fourteen named rows as of 2025-12-31. It establishes no more specific physical stage, construction-start date, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.historical_status_guardrail: The filing reports a historical status as of 2025-12-31 and does not prove that any project's status remained unchanged, advanced, or completed after 2025-12-31.
metadata.target_date_guardrail: Each target-open value is a reported calendar quarter, not an exact date. It remains evidence metadata and creates no target_date, commissioning, completion, or operational lifecycle observation.
metadata.cabinet_guardrail: Sellable cabinets are reported units of marketable space subject to power limitations, not MW, critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid capacity, generation capacity, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption. They create no normalized capacity row.
metadata.capex_guardrail: Approximate total capex is a forward-looking dollar estimate that may change with final construction details. It is not power, energy, capacity, consumption, physical progress, or evidence of completion and creates no normalized capacity row.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The table reports no critical IT, gross facility demand, grid-connection capacity, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption for these projects, so no capacity row is created.
metadata.classification_guardrail: IBX, customer, interconnection, cloud, AI, and portfolio language elsewhere in the filing does not establish a normalized workload, operating model, tenant, customer, user, or installed hardware model for any listed project.
metadata.location_guardrail: The reported New York, Bogotá, Silicon Valley, Lagos, Dubai, Madrid, Hong Kong, Osaka, Jakarta, Sydney, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, and Chennai locations are retained only as authoritative metro, city, or region localities. The filing does not establish street addresses, parcels, points, footprints, geometries, co-location among differently coded facilities, or unique-site counts. SV18 phase 1 reuses the exact corrected SV18 campus identity; OS3 and OS6 remain separately coded campus identities.
metadata.role_guardrail: The filer, executives, customers, suppliers, partners, landlords, and investors are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, utility, or other roles.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The filing supplies no project-specific PUE, energy, grid, generation, renewable-share, or measured-consumption observation for these fourteen rows.

metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, analyst geolocation, or image-based identity inference contributes to project identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, or classification.
metadata.extraction_scope: Exactly the fourteen rows enumerated in target_projects_as_reported that were not normalized by the corrected twenty-row complete-submission and EMEA ARS tranches or the seven earlier Inline XBRL sources; no other table row is normalized by this tranche.
metadata.kl2_combined_row_guardrail: The filing provides one combined KL2 phases 1 and 2 row. It supports exactly one combined project and one lifecycle observation; it does not support separate phase 1 and phase 2 entities, status rows, cabinet allocations, capex allocations, or opening targets.
metadata.subsequent_event_guardrail: Later reports that HK6 or MD5 opened are outside this extraction scope and are not evidence inputs. They do not alter, supersede, or reinterpret the historical 2025-12-31 lifecycle observations in this tranche.
